root_notes: Proved: definitions, the equal-orbit period, local orbit labelling, kernel invariance and the ±1 sign character (nut_sign_character). Prior-art gate: no resolution. Bottleneck: completeness of the symmetry-reduced finite enumeration (a labelled search is about 1.4e10 signed matrices; the 7,176 certificates need a verified reduction, and the unsigned pretest must also be formalized). r2 is relaunched to close the general reduction (gaps 1-3, 5) into a single explicit finite proposition, and to deliver a measured finite-check design and pilot.
